headline: Trump changes tactics toward Russia. Media reveal behind-the-scenes details
summary: The US reportedly dropped offers of contracts and investment to Russia in exchange for ending the war in Ukraine, with talks now focused on territory and security, according to the Financial Times. Washington denies the report.
why: US policy toward Russia shapes sanctions, energy markets and European defence spending, all of which feed into global asset prices.
original_headline: Trump zmienia taktykę wobec Rosji. Media ujawniają kulisy
